generations.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: ONE independent transparent character pose sprite CH01_DISCUSSING for Cogna ART-29 quarterly DRE.
Input image 1 is CH01 canonical identity master: lock her exact adult face, warm medium brown skin, brown eyes, above-shoulder dark-brown wavy side-parted bob, gold hoop earrings, lilac button-down shirt with rolled sleeves, graphite belted trousers, adult proportions and clean contour/cel shading. Input image 2 is the approved quarterly concept: use ONLY the woman's conversational orientation and the warm upper-left lighting; do not reproduce its scene or props.
Primary request: redraw ONLY this same woman seated in professional discussion, three-quarter torso and attentive face turned slightly toward image RIGHT to look at a mentor who will be a separate sprite. Natural subtle friendly smile. Her image-left elbow is bent with relaxed fingers near her chin, attentive listening gesture. Her image-right arm extends gently toward image RIGHT with an EMPTY small pinch grip at chest/lower-chest level, prepared to meet the RIGHT edge of a separate upright report sheet placed just to the left of those fingers. No paper in this image; empty transparent gap between arms. Fingers anatomically coherent. Seated pelvis and graphite-clad upper thighs visible below waist, legs bent toward image right. Frame stops cleanly at upper thighs, no furniture. Both arms and hands fully visible and comfortably inside frame. All fingers drawn, no detached parts.
Composition: desired 768x1024 portrait RGBA canvas, character centered, top of head at about 12% height, upper thighs ending by 89% height; retain at least 10% transparent breathing room at ALL edges. Face/torso/hand proportions match master. Front-facing camera with slight descending view consistent with sitting at frontal desk. Pose above intended desk edge, no actual desk. Warm diffuse light from upper left, restrained shadows down-right.
Style: polished adult editorial cartoon exactly matching canonical master, plum/ink outlines, restrained broad cel-shaded planes, soft warm skin and lilac cloth. NO manga style or child proportions.
Background: TRUE RGBA transparency, alpha ZERO outside person and in every gap. No glow, gradient haze, cast shadow cloud, checkerboard, floor or scenery.
Constraints: ONE person only; NO mentor, chair, desk, table, paper, report, clipboard, pen, mug, calculator, other props, text, labels, numbers, data, chart, logo, UI or watermark. Do not copy reference background. Keep identity and wardrobe unchanged, change only pose/expression/orientation.

generations.prompt:

No desk, chair, table, paper, props, other person, text, numbers, chart, watermark or UI. Change only lower arm placement and seated leg height needed to fit a desk.
generations.revision_reason: Lift resting hand above waist and lower thighs so full hands remain visible while desk hides seated lower body.
